sn22.137:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Yam bhikkhave aniccaṃ tatra vo chando pahātabbo || || Kiñca bhikkhave aniccaṃ || || Rūpam bhikkhave aniccaṃ || tatra vo chando pahātabbo || || Vedanā aniccā || || Saññā || || Saṅkhārā || || Viññāṇam aniccaṃ || tatra vo chando pahātabbo || || Yam bhikkhave aniccaṃ tatra vo chando pahātabbo ti || ||
